tasks.short: Develop and monitor image quality procedures

steps.what: Develop and monitor procedures for adequate image quality control

tasks.design: Retain procedure development and image-quality monitoring with the radiologist using the existing {OTHER} imaging review system. Numeric checks may support judgement, but no automatic image-adequacy decision is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Adequacy depends on the clinical question and acquisition conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported reduction in clinical quality-control time is established here.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing acceptable limitations from a need for repeat imaging.

reach.learn: How acquisition choices affect clinical adequacy

evidence.claim: The task requires clinical procedure development and quality judgement; a removable administrative baseline is not established.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing imaging review system; use native tools before changes.
Actual quality evidence is produced through counted review and existing acquisition work; no free adequate-image flag.
No extra repeat-imaging savings are assumed.
No changed workflow means no incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Is any repeated quality-data assembly distinct from clinical review?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Clinical quality work retains full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Provide counseling on processes, risks, benefits and alternatives and check patient understanding

tasks.design: Retain patient-specific explanation and understanding checks with the radiologist. {DOCS} can supply current information sheets without replacing the conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Risks and alternatives must be explained in the patient's context.
tasks.enabler_now: No shortening of patient counselling is assumed.

reach.learn: Which concerns need a clinician's explanation

evidence.claim: Information sheets do not establish a reduction in individual clinical counselling time.

assumptions: Only direct counselling is counted; no invented leaflet-production baseline.
Understanding is checked through the counted conversation, not supplied as a structured flag.
research_questions: Which explanations most often need adaptation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; direct counselling remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Establish and enforce standards protecting patients and personnel during radiological work

tasks.design: Keep protection-standard decisions and enforcement with the radiologist and relevant safety professionals. {DOCS} supplies controlled guidance without treating checklist completion as proof of safety.
tasks.previous_blocker: Protection depends on clinical conditions and actual practice.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported replacement of safety judgement is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising exceptions and enforcing appropriate controls.

reach.learn: How practical conditions expose gaps in standards

evidence.claim: Protection-standard development and enforcement remain contextual work; no clerical saving is established here.

assumptions: Clinical and physical safety work is in scope, without added document-formatting work.
Actual compliance evidence requires counted observation; no free safe-to-proceed flag.
Use existing controlled guidance and safety systems.
research_questions: Which exceptions require direct safety-professional review?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Safety judgement and enforcement retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare and verify referral details needed to coordinate radiological services
Coordinate clinical priorities, dependencies and timing with other medical professionals

tasks.design: Configure a native coordination brief in the existing {OTHER} clinical referral system to reuse verified referral details. The radiologist still checks inputs and discusses priorities, dependencies and timing with colleagues.
tasks.previous_blocker: Referral details may be retyped into coordination messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse existing record fields without generating clinical decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling competing clinical needs and changing patient conditions.

reach.learn: How clinical decisions affect preparation and sequencing

evidence.claim: Native clinical forms can reuse checked referral fields; this does not automate clinical prioritisation or establish a measured saving.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing clinical referral system; try native views before custom integration.

The referring clinician produces patient identity, referral identifier, clinical question and requested service during referral creation. In s1 the radiologist checks these fields, current plan/version, recipient and relevant dependencies; checking and missing-field capture remain in the 10 retained hours per 100 baseline.

Referring clinicians maintain source records in existing care, with 3 incremental other-role hours allowed for additional corrections. Missing details require direct clarification; no ready priority or patient-prepared flag is assumed.
Other clinicians' assessments are obtained through s2 discussion, not available before their contribution. Only repeat entry changes; existing automatic views give zero savings.
research_questions: Does field reuse reduce total coordination time after verification and clarification?

incremental.description: Form checks and additional exception review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90, gross=10%; minus 4 focal upkeep gives net 6%. Range 0-2% covers already integrated referrals and mostly live clinical coordination; E1 scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Clinical radiology with simpler coordination preparation
reach: Review referral information quality with clinical colleagues
role.ambitious_version: Native record reuse reduces repeated entry while quality, safety and patient decisions retain full professional attention.
